attempted_axis: camera.c whole-TU pass for work_claim.cameradata-sweep.20260831.v1: adopt the new include/game/cameradata.h, convert the TU's 27 raw `state + 0xNN` displacements to offsetof() addends on the unchanged raw base, collapse the file-local CameraStateView's 15 duplicate offsetof spellings onto the shared header so one authority owns the layout, then sweep the TU's 51 pool-literal externs per function.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.walked-base-symbol-identity.20260830.v1: APPLIED and DECISIVE, with a BOUNDARY FOUND -- the fnasm.py relocation check was run on all 9 camera-state functions and 8 (do_camera, camera_init_for_gamemode, camera_mode_follow, camera_orbit_update, camera_mode_level, camera_mode_spin, debug_camera_pos, camera_debug_supervisor) relocate @gCameraState, but camera_collide_step relocates @gCameras instead. That single exception is exactly the per-function hazard the law describes and is why its accesses were left &gCameras[i]-derived and NOT routed through the view. claim.law.gCameraState-blob-vs-typed-camera-base.20260831.v1: APPLIED, and this TU supplies the counter-example that completes it. claim.law.embedded-struct-member-whole-tu-cascade.20260831.v1: APPLIED as design constraint AND as method -- the aggregate-bearing CameraStateView was DELIBERATELY KEPT FILE-LOCAL (it carries Camera cameras[6] and CameraTarget targets[15]) and only its 0xC8 prefix size was re-pointed at the header's CAMERA_STATE_CAMERAS_OFF; the header include was gated alone first (GATE OK). claim.law.typed-global-member-vs-view-cast-diverges.20260831.v1: APPLIED and DECISIVE for the keep/delete decision -- that law states a pre-existing view cast is evidence about the ORIGINAL source shape, not debt, so do_camera and camera_init_for_gamemode kept their `(CameraStateView*)gCameraState` member access rather than being rewritten to raw casts, which would have re-introduced fakematch debt to remove a duplicate. claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction.20260831.v1: APPLIED as a prohibition -- the pre-existing `camIdx * sizeof(Camera)` in camera_mode_follow is NOT a loop stride and was left untouched; no new sizeof stride introduced. claim.law.extern-scalar-read-defeats-fp-literal-hoist.20260831.v1: SCREENED and probed on all 6 sub-100% functions; NOT APPLICABLE in this TU (see residual). claim.law.literal-sweep-needs-lfd-stfd-tell-first.20260831.v1 and claim.law.literal-sweep-pays-on-fpr-allocation-without-the-lfd-tell.20260831.v1 (both landed mid-pass): APPLIED retroactively and they PREDICT this TU's negative result exactly -- no function here shows the lfd/stfd tell, and every one probed has an IDENTICAL-or-near multiset with a LOW real-per-insn ratio (camera_mode_level 62/582 = 0.11, camera_mode_dest 166/682 = 0.24, camera_mode_follow 386/1048 = 0.37, camera_debug_supervisor 372/1008 = 0.37, camera_collide_step 266/444 = 0.60), which is the FPR-allocation law's clause (c) 'multiset IDENTICAL and real already low -> skip: literalization can only cost relocation names there'. The measured outcomes (all NEUTRAL or REGRESSED) are that clause's cost model showing up directly. claim.law.tu-wide-literalization-breaks-matched-sibling-pool-relocs.20260831.v1: APPLIED as a hard constraint -- nothing was literalized TU-wide and no retained substitution exists in this TU at all. claim.law.cached-base-alias-defeats-rematerialized-index-base.20260831.v1: SCREENED as the alternative lever; not attempted this pass and left open. claim.law.explicit-fp-symbol-vs-literal-zero-regression.20260830.v1: APPLIED, strongly confirmed -- the f32 0.0f sentinel regressed catastrophically in every camera.c function tried.

attributes.residual: Conversion is complete for every site whose base traces to the gCameraState walk. LEFT ALONE deliberately, with cause: (1) camera_collide_step's accesses -- its target relocates @gCameras, so routing them through the gCameraState view would re-attribute the address to the wrong symbol; (2) do_camera and camera_init_for_gamemode's CameraStateView member access -- form-preserving evidence of the original source shape per typed-global-member-vs-view-cast-diverges. POOL-LITERAL AXIS IS A CLEAN NEGATIVE FOR THIS WHOLE TU (do-not-retry): camera_collide_step 266, camera_debug_supervisor 372, camera_mode_dest 166, camera_mode_follow 386, camera_mode_level 62 -- every group NEUTRAL or REGRESSED, all reverted. The mechanical reason is visible in the counts: these functions already have EXACT instruction counts (444/444, 1006/1008, 682/682, 1048/1048, 582/582), i.e. their residual is pure register/schedule with no missing-hoist structure for a literal to supply.
